moments.title: Digital gold and gold funds are meant to be backed by physical gold held for you
moments.summary: The speaker explains that when you buy a rupee of digital gold, the company is buying and storing physical gold against it, and that gold mutual funds work the same way.
moments.evidence: these are companies who are actually selling you this digital gold okay and the thing is it's always backed by physical gold

moments.title: You pay roughly a one percent premium for the storing, and the price still tracks gold
moments.summary: On cost: if gold is a hundred rupees you pay about a one percent premium because someone is doing the buying and storing, but the holding still follows the trend of gold prices.
moments.evidence: you'll obviously pay like of that one percent premium because they're doing the storing buying
